extDescription.message: Lets the assistant in your platform conversations work in this browser, on the sites you allow.

unsupportedPageHint.message: This page cannot be shared. Switch to a regular webpage.

noConversationHint.message: Start a conversation with the assistant on the platform, then return here to share.

assistantPageHint.message: Opened by the assistant for the conversation below.

sharedPageHint.message: This page is shared with the conversation below.

sitesRemovalHint.message: After removal, every conversation will need new authorization to access this site.

privacyAccess.message: The assistant only accesses tabs it opens for a conversation or you share with it.

privacyBody.message: Page content read by the assistant is sent to your selected model and saved in conversation history. The extension monitors changes in platform sign-in status and does not read, store or send the values of sign-in cookies. With your confirmation, page scripts may access data available to scripts on that page, including non-HttpOnly cookies and local storage.

privacyRetention.message: After conversation deletion, platform retention rules apply. The browser debugging banner cannot be hidden; its Cancel button stops the assistant.

settingsIntro.message: Usually no change is needed. Use this only to connect to a different platform environment.

helpPending.message: Contact details are pending approval. Use the platform’s existing help entry to send feedback.

developmentPending.message: This project was jointly completed by the Student Assistant Development Team and the Information Technology Services Office.

stateWaiting_login.message: Sign in on the platform website first; it reconnects by itself afterwards

stateReplaced.message: This browser has a newer connection elsewhere; paused

stateProtocol_unsupported.message: This extension is out of date; please update it

stateError.message: The platform refused the connection; retrying later

stateOrigin_not_allowed.message: The platform has not registered this extension, so it stopped connecting; ask the platform administrators to register it, then click Reconnect

displayNameHint.message: When you have several browsers, you pick one by this name in the conversation.

serverOriginHint.message: Enter an http:// or https:// origin, with an optional port. Do not include a path, query, fragment or sign-in details. Only the platform connection address is saved locally.

serverSwitchHint.message: Switching disconnects the current connection and clears all allowed sites, shared pages and takeover states. Webpages stay open. Sign in to the new platform again.

serverPermissionHint.message: Access to the current platform address has not been granted. Use the same save button to grant access and connect. Your browser will ask for access to the entered host.

serverInvalidOrigin.message: Enter only an http:// or https:// origin, with an optional port and no path, query, fragment or sign-in details.

serverStateUnavailable.message: The current connection settings are unavailable. Open Advanced settings again to refresh them.

serverPermissionDenied.message: Access was not granted. The platform connection address was not changed. Click save again if you want to retry.

serverSaveFailed.message: Could not save and switch. Check the current address and try again.

serverSaved.message: Platform address changed. Previous allowed sites, shared pages and takeover states were cleared. Sign in to the new platform.

serverRolledBack.message: The new platform could not be reached. The original address was restored automatically. Previous access, sharing and takeover states were cleared. Check the address and try again.

globalResumeHint.message: This resumes new actions globally. Conversations you took over still need their own Continue button.

controlledHint.message: Continue each conversation explicitly. The assistant must read the page again and will not replay cancelled actions.

readOnlyHint.message: This device currently only reads shared single-document pages. Open a page yourself, share it here, and grant site access if needed. Opening pages and other actions are unavailable; pages with frames are rejected.

noActionsHint.message: This device has no browser actions available. It will reject browser tool requests.

pageAccessNoControls.message: Access to the selected site was granted, but the page controls could not be confirmed. Use this popup to manage the conversation.

showControls.message: Grant site access and show controls

controlsHint.message: Grant access to this site to read shared pages and show the conversation's task and takeover controls. Collapsing controls does not stop actions.

controlPermissionDenied.message: Site access was not granted. No controls were added.

controlObserve.message: Read the page again before continuing

controlStateWorking.message: The assistant is operating this page

controlStateUser.message: You are in control. The assistant has stopped.

controlActionIdle.message: Waiting for the assistant’s next step

controlActionWaiting.message: Please confirm in the separate confirmation window.

controlActionTaking.message: Waiting for the extension to confirm disconnection.

controlActionUser.message: The assistant will check the page again before continuing.

controlActionObserve.message: The assistant checks the page again. It will not repeat previously canceled actions.

controlAction_wait.message: Waiting for the page to change

controlHelp.message: Taking over cancels the ongoing action. Clicks or submissions already sent cannot be undone.

controlCollapseLabel.message: Collapse the control bar without stopping the assistant

controlUnavailable.message: Control could not be confirmed. Use the extension popup to stop the assistant.

autoMode.message: In Auto Mode, let the platform's review confirm for me

autoModeHint.message: New sites, password fields, uploads, downloads and page scripts: when the conversation is in Auto Mode they go to the platform's automatic review first; you are asked only if it blocks them. Turn this off to always be asked.

stopHint.message: Stops ongoing actions in all conversations. Webpages stay open.

stopped.message: Stopped: the assistant cannot use the browser now.

share.message: Share this page with the assistant

shareTargetNext.message: Will share with the next conversation that uses the browser

shareTargetRecent.message: Will share with the conversation that used the browser most recently

shareHint.message: Once shared, the assistant can act on this site (for that conversation only).

shared.message: This tab is shared with the assistant

sharePending.message: Shared: the next conversation that uses the browser gets it.

intro1.message: The assistant only works in tabs it opens for this conversation and tabs you share with it. Tabs are grouped when available; otherwise ordinary tabs are used. Drag a grouped tab out of its AI group to revoke control, or close an ordinary tab to remove access. Stop cancels current actions and releases control; retained tabs remain available for new actions after you resume.

intro2.message: New sites, password fields, uploads, downloads and page scripts need confirmation; scripts can read this site's sign-in data. In Auto Mode (the default) the platform's automatic review decides, and you are asked only if it blocks; in step-by-step mode you are asked every time. To keep the review out, turn off the switch below or put the conversation in step-by-step mode.

intro3.message: While the assistant works, the browser shows a bar saying the extension started debugging this browser; it cannot be hidden. Clicking Cancel on it stops the assistant.

intro4.message: Page content the assistant reads is sent to the model you chose in the conversation and saved in the conversation history.

intro5.message: The assistant never reads or writes cookies or local storage, and does not touch your other tabs.

approvalTitleSite.message: Allow the assistant to access this site?

approvalSiteBody.message: Allow: this conversation will not ask again for this site. Always allow this site: no conversation will ask again. You can remove access in the extension.

approvalNavigateBody.message: The assistant will leave the current site and open the destination above. Allow applies to this conversation only; Always allow this site applies to every conversation.

approvalTitlePassword.message: Allow the assistant to enter a password?

approvalPasswordBody.message: You can choose to enter it yourself. Password contents are not shown in this window.

approvalTitleSelf.message: Enter it yourself on the original page

selfTypeBody.message: The cursor is in that field. Finish entering it on the original page, then choose “Input complete”.

approvalUploadBody.message: If you allow this, the files above will be sent to this website.

approvalDownloadBody.message: The click that triggered this download has already happened. Your choice only controls the download. Please check for page changes.

approvalDownloadNote.message: The file goes to the conversation, not to your downloads folder.

approvalTitleScript.message: Allow this page script to run?

approvalScriptBody.message: The script will run in this page and may read this site’s sign-in data and send it elsewhere. Review the script before deciding.

approvalReview.message: The platform's automatic review blocked this step:

approvalCountdown.message: $1 seconds left · If you do not confirm in time, waiting ends. Please check the page.

approvalKeyboardNote.message: Default: Decline. Esc or closing submits a decline. Expiry is recorded separately from an explicit decline.

approvalSubmitting.message: Submitting the response. This window closes automatically once the backend receives it.

approvalExpiredBody.message: If you do not confirm in time, waiting ends. Please check the page.
